Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly identified Louis XIV as Philip V's father instead of Louis, Grand Dauphin. The mistake stems from a misinterpretation of the familial relationship. Philip V was the grandson of Louis XIV, not his son. The WebSurfer's searches failed to accurately verify this familial connection, leading to the incorrect identification of Louis XIV as Maria Luisa of Savoy's father-in-law.
